about: The tool library's five member questions, each with one right figure and its unit. A planted run answers the question the written task asks, recognised from its prompt; a task asking something else gets the whole handbook in one reply and is not counted. The bad replies are near misses: an extra digit, the right number with the wrong unit, a dodge.

bot: a volunteer-run lending library for tools
Every tool carries a yellow tag with its number

missing.bot: no arm's program gives the bot both its system prompt (bot/system.md) and its handbook (bot/knowledge.md), so the suite does not measure the bot

dodge: I'm not able to help with that. Please ask a volunteer at the counter.
unrecognised: none of the written tasks asks one of the questions in notes/member-questions.md

answers.*: Loans are 9 days. The late fee is $0.75 a day for each tool. Membership is $12 a year. You can reserve up to 3 weeks ahead, power tools need a $40 deposit, and deposits are refunded within 5 working days.

answers.loan: You can keep any tool for 9 days, large or small. If nobody has reserved it, you can renew once at the counter or by email.
answers.fee: The late fee is $0.75 per day for each tool, up to the tool's replacement cost. Fees are waived during the January stocktake.
answers.membership: Membership is $12 per year, and it runs from the month you join. Under-18s can borrow with a parent or guardian who is a member.
answers.reserve: You can reserve a tool up to 3 weeks ahead, and we hold it for 2 days after your pickup date.
answers.refund: Thanks for bringing it back! Your deposit is refunded to your card within 5 working days, as long as the tool came back undamaged.
